, '' AS SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호 , #{CASE_MNG_NO} AS CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수
, T2.SRVC_PVSN_NO AS SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호 , T3.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수

WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.DEL_YN != 'Y'
, SEB520 T2 /* 자원프로그램제공대상자 */ , SEB100 T3 /* 사례기본 */ WHERE 1 = 1 AND T1.RESRCE_NO = T2.RESRCE_NO AND T1.PROGRM_NO = T2.PROGRM_NO AND T3.CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND T2.SRVC_PVSN_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_NO} AND T2.DEL_YN != 'Y'
AND T1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} ORDER BY T1.RESRCE_NO, T1.PROGRM_NO

MERGE /* isry.itgcm.casemng.caseunity.CaseExcnMapper.saveSEB500Data(서비스제공저장) */ INTO SEB500 T1 /* 서비스제공 */ USING DUAL ON (T1.SRVC_PVSN_NO = #{SRVC_PVSN_NO} AND T1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO})
WHEN MATCHED THEN
UPDATE SET
SRVC_PVSN_MTHD_SE_CD = #{SRVC_PVSN_MTHD_SE_CD}, SRVC_PVSN_TTL_NM = #{SRVC_PVSN_TTL_NM}, SRVC_PVSN_CN = #{SRVC_PVSN_CN}, SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD = #{SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD}, SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD = #{SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD}, SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR = #{SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR}, SRVC_PVSN_END_HR = #{SRVC_PVSN_END_HR}, SRVC_PVSN_WHDA_YN = CASE WHEN #{SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_HR} IS NULL AND #{SRVC_PVSN_END_HR} IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO}, PIC_NO = #{PIC_NO}, TKCG_INST_NO = #{TKCG_INST_NO}, ATFINO = #{ATFINO}, LAST_MDFR_ID = #{USER_ID}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE
